# Rook.works

Rook.works is Jacob Herrmann's portfolio for business operations analysis, HR systems, reporting, workflow design, and practical automation.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://rook.works/): Overview of services and selected work.
- [Projects](https://rook.works/projects/): Case studies and working demonstrations.
- [Resume](https://rook.works/grid/resume.html): Professional background and experience.
- [Contact](https://rook.works/grid/contact.html): Contact information.
